build-callsign.title: Build a call sign
build-callsign.prompt: Build a valid call sign for Ontario.
hints: Canadian prefixes are VA, VE, VO and VY.
build-callsign.success: VA3 or VE3, then two or three letters: an Ontario call sign.

id-timing.title: When to identify
id-timing.prompt: Mark when you'd give your call sign during this 70-minute contact.
hints: Start, end, and no gap over 30 minutes.
id-timing.success: At the start, at the end, and never more than 30 minutes apart.
